Messages.Author: Oracle.kid
Messages.Body:
Hi there,

a friend and I are planning to run a V5 tournament. While doing so, we came (again) across clarity issues, which cards can be officially considered V5.

In every discussion (e.g. in the Discord) I've witnessed about this topic, people appear to have different understandings about what cards V5 should contain. So we thought an official statement would be helpful. The reason for this is clarity - people could gain a congruent "feel" for V5. As of now, every organizer can of course make a custom limited format. But this bears (on a middle-range timescale) the risk of a wide variety of "V5" terms being established and cause confusion.

In the vdb-Link you find a list of cards including all Precons as well as New Blood and FoL and Promo Pack 3. But there are several single promos which aren't as clear (some of them are included as well):
Promo Pack 2: Are the G6 Barons supposed to be V5? Is Murmur of the False Will?
Single Promos: Charisma, Boleslaw Gutowski, Kuyen, Direct Intervention, Maila, Anarch Convert, Fee Stakes Corte, LA, Perth

Thanks in advance

vdb.im/decks/053a72e7c8174c60b29a293cbb705c8b

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
IANBCP, but here's my take:
Yes to Promo Pack 2 Barons. (only thing that predates V5 set release that seems like it should be included)
No to rest of Promo Pack 2 (those were reprints for text migrations)
No to Charisma. (predates V5)
Yes to Boleslaw
Yes to Kuyen
No to DI. There simply isn't a lot of cancel in V5. Don't introduce it with a promo.
Yes to Maila (though feel free to say no because of its limited distribution if that makes it more fair for the player base)
Yes to Anarch Convert
Yes to Fee Stakes Corte, LA, and Perth
